name: Dream Vacation Pitch
description: Suggest dream destinations, rank the AI-merged shortlist as a class, then collaboratively write a vacation pitch for the winner, one sentence at a time.

submit-destinations.prompt: Where's your dream vacation destination? (City, country, or place)

shortlist.instruction: These are dream vacation destinations suggested by a class. Merge duplicates and near-duplicates ("Paris" + "paris france" = one entry), then pick the 6 most popular or most interesting distinct destinations. Use clean display names ("Paris, France"). Return ONLY a JSON array of 6 destination strings, nothing else. If there are fewer than 6 distinct destinations, return however many there are.

rank-destinations.prompt: Rank the shortlist from BEST to WORST

write-pitch.prompt:
Top pick: {{rank-destinations.rankings.0.item}}

Add the next sentence to the class's vacation pitch about it. Build on what came before, make it exciting!

end.message: Thanks for playing Dream Vacation Debate! Start packing!

recommendedFor: Class makes a collective choice. Strong for persuasive-writing practice.
